summary: Ad hoc ansible commands use a separate stdout callback, so you must set bin_ansible_callbacks=True in [defaults] or ANSIBLE_LOAD_CALLBACK_PLUGINS=1 for them to use the configured callback.
questions: Why doesn't my stdout_callback apply to ad hoc ansible commands?
How do I make ad hoc commands load callback plugins?
Which environment variable enables callbacks for /usr/bin/ansible?

answer_card.title: Using callbacks with ad hoc commands
answer_card.answer_md:
Ad hoc commands use a different stdout callback. To make them use your configured callbacks:

```ini
[defaults]
bin_ansible_callbacks=True
```

or

```shell
export ANSIBLE_LOAD_CALLBACK_PLUGINS=1
```
